superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da pretvorim Connectorove suprotne promene mrežnih maksimuma u suprotne trendove po naseljima: to su mrežni ekstremi, a ne uparene promene na pojedinačnim stanicama. Ne mogu ni da ih nazovem trenutnim stanjem na ulicama: poslednji prijem SEPA podataka bio je pre 57 min, a oznake sati zahtevaju UTC korekciju. [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9][F2][F3]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot turn Connector's opposing network maxima into opposing neighborhood trends: these are network extremes, not paired changes at individual stations [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9]. I cannot call them current street conditions either: SEPA's last reception was 57 min ago, and its hour labels require a UTC correction [F2][F3].
